sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aim of this module is to equip students with an understanding of basic chemistry, laying a foundation for students to pursue further study in chemistry.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Understand and discuss structure and properties of the main-group elements in the periodic table B discuss the nature of chemical bonding and the geometry of molecules C discuss the significance of chemical equilibrium D understand simple rate equations and the importance of reaction kinetic in determining reaction mechanisms E discuss reactivity of organic compounds with respect to their functional groups F discuss fundamental properties of general thermodynamic terms Gibbs free energy and entropy
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The module consists of 21 hours lectures, with 14 hours tutorials
